Presented below are lists of famous or notable [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] people of [[Jewish]] [[Cultural heritage|descent]] and other Jews born in the territory of present-day [[Ukraine]], before 20 century borderland region in [[Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth]] (later in [[Russian Partition]] and [[Austrian Partition]]).
